findings.what: The Go back script goes back only when `ours && history.length > 1`. The spec's "Go back" decision says to go back when document.referrer is same-origin, and it rejects `history.length > 1` as a condition. The extra guard is a departure from that decision. The AC-8 test checks only that the script mentions referrer, location.origin and history.back.
findings.fix: Remove `&& history.length > 1` so the condition is just the same-origin referrer. Alternatively, record the owner's call on the guard in the spec.

findings.what: The `/`-with-no-items row of the state table is only partly tested. The existing empty-table test checks "No items yet." and nothing else. It does not check that the list is hidden, that the filter links show with All current, or that Go back is hidden. No test checks that "Go back" is absent on any 200 state row.
findings.fix: In the empty-table test, assert there is no <ul> or <li>, that All is current, and that there is no "Go back". Also assert there is no "Go back" on the `/` and `?category=<known>` states.

findings.what: The 404 page has the title and heading "Broken link", which the spec does not call for. The spec only requires the message and a Go back link. The extra heading is minor.
findings.fix: Drop the extra heading, or leave it and accept the small addition.
